verification.notes: The transcript presents a speculative either/or about how TMZ obtained the neighborhood surveillance clip. TMZ reported that it obtained the video and that the videos were turned over to law enforcement, but did not identify who supplied TMZ or establish the order of transfer. FOX 13 separately reported that federal and local officers were collecting neighborhood footage and quoted Erwin Steele saying forensic personnel would acquire a camera card, but it likewise did not identify the source of TMZ's copy. No public source found establishes either branch of the claim, so the transfer chain remains unverifiable rather than false.
